choice.basis: The y-axis is labeled 'Emergency department visits' with ascending tick marks from 0 to 3200, and the x-axis spans 2012 to 2023. The plotted red line begins at a vertex corresponding to approximately 1200 visits in 2012 and ends at a vertex corresponding to approximately 3200 visits in 2023. Because the 2023 endpoint is plotted significantly higher on the scale than the 2012 starting point, the overall utilization pattern across the review period is one of growth, despite the contradictory title text. This measured change supports the growth pathway.
